operation.source_intent: Reconcile a PayPal-bound subscription from a fresh authoritative provider snapshot, applying only newer provider evidence without fabricating payment success

semantics.provider_read: PayPal GET /v1/billing/subscriptions/{provider-reference}; browser returns and accepted commands are never success evidence
semantics.freshness: provider observation must be newer than last_provider_event_at to mutate local state; stale or duplicate snapshots are audited without mutation
semantics.reference_integrity: returned provider subscription reference must match the selected encrypted provider binding
semantics.plan_mapping: provider plan changes apply only through a unique local PayPal plan mapping
semantics.state_mapping: provider status is mapped through the canonical Laravel subscription state machine; invalid transitions do not override local state
semantics.period_mapping: provider period timestamps are accepted only as a complete ordered pair

security.subscription_ownership: TenantSubscription global tenant scope rejects foreign direct IDs
security.csrf: web route stack retained for POST mutation
security.audit: immutable tenant-scoped BillingAudit records trusted actor, support reason, masked provider reference, provider status, provider evidence time and request context

coverage: exact canonical operation identity and route marker
platform-admin middleware plus guest and non-admin denial
caller-owned tenant, actor, provider, plan, payment and provider-evidence fields rejected
authoritative PayPal snapshot reference and provider-binding integrity
newer provider evidence updates local plan and billing period with authoritative reread
failed provider call releases incomplete idempotency state so the same key can retry
immutable audit contains masked provider reference and no payment-success inference
provider credential/reference is never returned to browser
active-tenant frontend contract binding and browser idempotency header
